statements.statement: The patient has a history of unspecified atrial fibrillation (I48.91)
The patient reports persistent episodes of palpitations that interfere with daily activities
The service is for continuous ambulatory electrocardiographic recording
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
The denial reason is that this specific service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
The service is medically necessary to evaluate the clinical indication of palpitations and manage the diagnosed cardiac conditions
